title: Simulation studio
subtitle: Run the app development process model in your browser with the same simulator as the report.

labels.first_load: The first visit downloads Python and its packages, about 36 MB. Your browser keeps them for the next visit.
labels.lint_ok: No problems found. The model follows the book's rules.
labels.lint_count: Errors: {errors}. Warnings: {warnings}. Errors stop the model from running, warnings don't.
labels.run_blocked_errors: Fix the model errors below to run.
labels.run_blocked_unreadable: The model can't be read, so it can't run.
labels.suggestions_intro: The four changes of the redesign, from the report's change catalog. They work on the as-is model. Applying or undoing one sets all parameters to the catalog's values.
labels.suggestions_checking: Checking whether the suggestions fit the model…
labels.suggestions_unavailable: You changed the diagram by hand, so the suggestions no longer fit it. They only work on the as-is model, with or without the changes below.
labels.suggestions_hand_params: Some parameters differ from the catalog's. Applying or undoing a change replaces them with the catalog's values.
labels.suggestion_diff: Last step: {added} added, {rerouted} reconnected, {removed} removed, {parameters} with new parameters. Changed elements have a green outline in the diagram.
labels.params_hint: Select a task, XOR split or lane in the diagram to edit its parameters.
labels.param_scale: Scales with the case attributes (from the parameter file, read only): {terms}
labels.param_branches: Share of cases that take each outgoing flow, summing to 1
labels.setting_whole_number: {setting} must be a whole number of at least {min}.
labels.import_hint: Pick a .bpmn file, a .params.toml file, or both. Missing parameters get studio defaults.
labels.defaults_none: None. Every parameter comes from the parameter file or your edits.
labels.dropped: Dropped the parameters of elements no longer in the model: {entries}.
